_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Interactive map card of the stage or the built walk: route, ferry piers and places to visit, with distance and an Open map button. The map is already rendered here — never build your own map or chart from the data, and do not repeat these details in text.

description: Show an interactive map of one trail section (stage) of the Stockholm Archipelago Trail, with the hiking route and ferry piers. Use this when the user wants to SEE a section on a map. Takes the same identifiers as fetch (sat:section:…, slug or uid). Pass targetKm (and optionally date) to draw a shorter or longer walk instead of the full stage. Do not use for comparing several stages side by side (use search/fetch). This tool renders an interactive map card itself — NEVER build your own map, chart, image or file from geojsonUrl or the coordinates; just call the tool and let the card show. IMPORTANT: every call to this tool renders a card in the conversation. Call it at most ONCE per answer, for the single option you recommend. Never use it to compare or probe alternatives. The card already shows ferry times, piers and walking times — do not restate them in your reply; add only advice, caveats and next steps.

date.description: Travel date, YYYYMMDD (Europe/Stockholm), e.g. 20260905. Only used with targetKm — the walk starts at the pier that day's ferry lands at. Defaults to today.

direction.description: Optional compass direction to steer a shorter walk towards: one of N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW — e.g. 'NE' to walk towards the north-east part of the island.

lang.description: Language of the user's message: 'sv' when the user writes in Swedish, otherwise 'en'. Always pass it — labels, dates and the card are rendered in this language.

section.description: Section reference: satId ("sat:section:2fxg6"), slug or uid — e.g. 'uto'.

targetKm.description: Desired walking distance in km, 1–60, e.g. 9. Pass when the user asks for a shorter or longer walk than the full stage (e.g. "about 9 km"). Omit for the full stage.

towards.description: Optional named place on the island (beach, viewpoint, café) to steer the walk towards, as shown by search/fetch — e.g. 'Stora Sandvik'.

name: show_section_map

pois.description: Points of interest on the stage (category-coloured markers).

url.description: Permanent link to this place in the app. When you mention a place by name in your reply, link it to this url.

route.description: Present with targetKm: the built walk as a GeoJSON LineString ([lon, lat]). The widget draws this instead of geojsonUrl.

suggestedFollowUps.description: Up to three short next steps, in English (e.g. "Make the walk shorter"). Offer these to the user as quick follow-up options at the end of your reply.

variantNote.description: Present when a requested targetKm walk could not be built: the full stage is shown instead. Tell the user this.

walk.description: Present when targetKm was passed: the actual walk that was built.
